# DriveBrandStudio component registry

> 451 React components for Tailwind CSS v4, distributed as a shadcn registry.

Install any component with the shadcn CLI. It rewrites imports to match the target project's `components.json`, so `cn` resolves to whatever the project already uses:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://components.drivedev.net/r/{name}.json
```

Full markdown for one component (description, props, source, attribution): https://components.drivedev.net/docs/{name}.md

## 3D & Canvas

- [3D Card](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/3d-card.md) — Card wrapper that tilts in 3D toward the pointer, with its text and image layered at different depths.
- [Attractor](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/attractor.md) — Physics field where the elements you drop in are pulled toward a fixed point and pushed away by the cursor.
- [Bookshelf](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/bookshelf.md) — Shelf of 3D hardback books, one per newsletter issue, with the title printed on each spine and cover.
- [Brick Breaker](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/brick-breaker.md) — Canvas brick breaker game with a paddle, a bouncing ball, lives, combo scoring and multiple levels.
- [Canvas Reveal](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/canvas-reveal.md) — Full-panel grid of tiny coloured dots rendered on a canvas, fading out into the background at the top.
- [Container Scroll](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/container-scroll.md) — Heading above a large device-style frame, tipped back in 3D, holding a grid of profile cards.
- [Cubes](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/cubes.md)
- [Globe](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/globe.md) — Rotating 3D globe with hexagon-dotted landmasses and coloured arcs flying between pairs of cities.
- [Iphone](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/iphone.md)
- [Lanyard](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/lanyard.md)
- [Lens](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/lens.md)
- [Macbook](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/macbook.md)
- [Model Viewer](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/model-viewer.md)
- [Orbit Gallery](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/orbit-gallery.md) — WebGL gallery of image tiles laid out on concentric rings that orbit a shared centre at different speeds.
- [Rubik Cube](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/rubik-cube.md) — An interactive 3D Rubik's cube component with multiple dimensions, visual modes, and smooth drag-to-rotate animations.
- [Sphere Gallery](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/sphere-gallery.md) — WebGL gallery of images mapped onto a sphere that you can orbit and focus.
- [Spinning Ring](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/spinning-ring.md)
- [Spiral 3D Slider](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/spiral-3d-slider.md)
- [Webcam Pixel Grid](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/webcam-pixel-grid.md)

## Forms & Inputs

- [Action Search Bar](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/action-search-bar.md) — Command-palette search field that lists matching actions with icons, shortcuts and type labels.
- [Checkbox Animated](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/checkbox-animated.md) — Checkbox drawn as a single continuous stroke that turns from a rounded square into a tick.
- [Curved Input](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/curved-input.md)
- [Dialog Form](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/dialog-form.md) — An interactive form component that transforms from a button into a modal dialog with smooth animations. Features form validation, loading states, and success feedback with beautiful visual effects.
- [Electric AI Input](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/electric-ai-input.md) — A modern AI-style input component with file upload support. Features smooth loading animations, customizable colors, and an intuitive interface perfect for AI chat applications.
- [Fancy Input](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/fancy-input.md)
- [File Input](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/file-input.md) — A sophisticated file upload component with drag-and-drop functionality, animated loading states, and file previews. Features file validation, size limits, and smooth transitions between upload states with beautiful visual feedback.
- [Gradient Checkbox](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/gradient-checkbox.md)
- [Input Animated](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/input-animated.md)
- [Interest Picker](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/interest-picker.md) — An interactive component that allows users to select their interests from a visually appealing marquee-style grid. Users can choose from predefined categories with smooth animations and a minimum selection requirement.
- [Leave Rating](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/leave-rating.md) — A fun and interactive rating component that lets users share their experience with a smiley face that changes based on their rating. Users can hover over star ratings to see the face transform from sad to happy, making feedback collection engaging and visually appealing.
- [Option Wheel](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/option-wheel.md) — Vertical picker whose options curl along an arc, fading and blurring the further each label sits from the selected one.
- [OTP Input](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/otp-input.md) — A six-digit OTP input component with smooth animations, auto-focus navigation, and visual feedback for verification success or errors.
- [Searchbar](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/searchbar.md)

Each image smoothly scales and slides into view, creating a dynamic waterfall effect where images flow from the sides and center themselves, making your gallery feel alive and responsive to every scroll movement.

Features a smooth red marker that moves across the bars to show your exact scroll position, creating an eye-catching glowing wave effect.

## Text Animations

- [Canvas Text](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/canvas-text.md) — Heading drawn on a canvas so its letterforms are filled with stacked coloured lines instead of solid colour.
- [Depth Text](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/depth-text.md)
- [Echo Text](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/echo-text.md) — Oversized headline trailed by a stack of tinted, progressively blurrier copies of itself, like a motion echo.
- [Flipping Text](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/flipping-text.md)
- [Letter3d Swap](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/letter3d-swap.md)
- [Particle Text](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/particle-text.md) — Text that dissolves into particles and reforms.
- [Random Letter Swap Hover](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/random-letter-swap-hover.md) — Text label whose characters flip over to an identical copy in a shuffled order, so the swap scatters across the word.
- [Scroll Float](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/scroll-float.md)
- [Scroll Reveal](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/scroll-reveal.md) — Large block of heading text that sits at a slight tilt and straightens as it scrolls into view, its words going from faint and blurred to solid.
- [Scroll Reveal Paragraph](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/scroll-reveal-paragraph.md) — Paragraph printed in faint grey that fills in to full contrast one word at a time, tied to how far it has scrolled up the screen.
- [Text Along Path](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-along-path.md)
- [Text Animate](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-animate.md) — Text primitive that reveals a heading by line, word or letter, with presets for fading, blurring, sliding and scaling.
- [Text Bounce](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-bounce.md) — Heading whose individual letters shy away from the pointer and spring back.
- [Text Cursor](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-cursor.md) — Pointer trail that drops a repeating character or emoji along the path of the cursor.
- [Text Flipping Board](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-flipping-board.md) — Airport split-flap departure board that spells out a message across a grid of hinged character tiles.
- [Text Loop](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-loop.md) — Endless ticker of repeating words riding a coloured ribbon bent into a wave, circle, infinity loop, arch or straight line.
- [Text Morph](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-morph.md)
- [Text Parallax Content](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-parallax-content.md)
- [Text Reveal](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-reveal.md)
- [Text Roll](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-roll.md)
- [Text Rotate](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-rotate.md)
- [Text Split](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-split.md)
- [Text Split2](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-split2.md) — Splits a string into letters or words so each piece can be animated independently.
- [Text Trail](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-trail.md)
- [Text Type](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/text-type.md)
- [Underline To Background](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/underline-to-background.md)
- [Vertical Cut Reveal](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/vertical-cut-reveal.md)
- [Word Tornado](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/word-tornado.md)

## Utilities

- [Ascii Converter](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/ascii-converter.md) — Two-pane tool that redraws an uploaded image as ASCII art, with controls for detail, character set and colour.
- [Color Picker](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/color-picker.md) — Swatch button that opens a picker panel with a saturation field, a rainbow hue slider, a hex input and preset chips.
- [Editor](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/editor.md)
- [Game 237](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/game-237.md) — First-person chase game set in a snowy 3D hedge maze, with a 60 second countdown and a red figure hunting you.
- [Page Transitions](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/page-transitions.md)
- [Pipeline](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/pipeline.md)
- [Sandbox](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/sandbox.md)
- [Sticky Countdown](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/sticky-countdown.md) — A slim announcement bar that sticks to the top of the page counting down the days, hours, minutes and seconds to a date.
- [System Banner](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/system-banner.md)
- [Theme Animations](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/theme-animations.md) — View-transition recipes for circular, blurred and polygonal theme switches.
- [Tool Tip](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/tool-tip.md)
- [Tour](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/tour.md)
- [Tour2](https://components.drivedev.net/docs/tour2.md)
